members.name: vwap_cross_momentum_v1
members.thesis: When price crosses above VWAP on elevated volume after being below for 20+ bars, it signals a regime shift: the marginal buyer is now paying above the session's volume-weighted fair value. Institutional VWAP-tracking algorithms that were selling now become buyers, creating a positive feedback loop.
members.exit_stop: VWAP (re-cross back below/above VWAP) OR 0.25% from entry, whichever is hit first
filters: no filter — momentum works in all VIX regimes
no entries before 09:45 (let VWAP stabilize) or after 14:45
volume surge > 2x 10-bar SMA on cross bar
prefer longs when NIFTY 50 is green for the day, shorts when red
weaknesses: In range-bound days, VWAP gets crossed many times — strategy generates false signals and accumulates losses
The 20-bar requirement means missing the first (most powerful) VWAP cross of the day
Volume surge threshold of 2x may be too aggressive, filtering out valid signals in low-vol stocks

members.name: gap_to_vwap_v1
members.thesis: After a gap open, the developing session VWAP acts as a gravitational attractor because institutional algorithms (TWAP/VWAP algos) that were scheduled to execute at VWAP will naturally pull price toward it. When price opens away from VWAP and diverges further, the institutional reversion pressure bu
entry_long: gap_pct < 0 (gap down, price extended below VWAP)
vwap_slope > 0 OR vwap_slope is flattening (VWAP not dropping sharply)
entry_short: gap_pct > 0 (gap up, price extended above VWAP)
members.exit_stop: vwap_dev_bps exceeds 40bps against position OR 0.4% from entry
filters: India_VIX < 20; high VIX causes wider VWAP deviations that may not revert
best entry window 09:25-11:00 IST; afternoon VWAP reversion is weaker
developing VWAP slope not > 0.5 bps/min (strong trend makes VWAP a moving target)
weaknesses: On strong trend days, VWAP itself moves in the trend direction, so price 'touching VWAP' may happen at a worse level than entry, creating a false win that's actually a loss on the trade
The 20bps VWAP deviation threshold generates many signals in volatile sessions but these are lower quality because the VWAP is still developing and noisy in the first 30 minutes
Developing VWAP in the first 30 minutes is heavily influenced by the gap itself, making early signals unreliable (circular reference problem)
members.prior_art: Berkowitz et al. (1988) VWAP benchmark; adapted for intraday gap trading. Biais et al. (1995) on price discovery and VWAP convergence.

members.name: vwap_anchored_support_v1
members.thesis: Anchored VWAP from significant prior events (earnings release, 52-week high/low, large gap day) acts as a persistent institutional memory of fair value from that event. members.exit_stop: 0.25% beyond anchored_VWAP (through the level means thesis is wrong)
filters: India_VIX < 25; anchored levels are less reliable in panic regimes
no entries in first 15 or last 15 min of session
prefer trades where anchored VWAP direction matches session VWAP direction
weaknesses: Requires maintaining a calendar of events and computing multi-day anchored VWAPs — significant data engineering overhead
Anchored VWAP levels that are too old (>30 days) lose their institutional memory relevance
Signal is rare — only triggers when price approaches a specific level, may have 0 trade days frequently
